description: This file defines functions and types related to approval delivery capabilities within a plugin SDK, including approval modes, target resolution, and capability creation for approval processes.

methods.name: buildApproverRestrictedNativeApprovalCapability
methods.description: Builds a channel approval capability with approval restrictions based on provided parameters.

methods.name: createApproverRestrictedNativeApprovalAdapter
methods.description: Creates an approval adapter by splitting the capability built with restrictions.

methods.name: createChannelApprovalCapability
methods.description: Constructs a channel approval capability object with optional approval behaviors.

methods.name: splitChannelApprovalCapability
methods.description: Splits a full channel approval capability into separate components for auth, delivery, render, and native.

methods.name: createApproverRestrictedNativeApprovalCapability
methods.description: Creates a native approval capability with restrictions based on parameters.
